Hi Elaine — great to hear the team is moving quickly. High level options below; I put the commercial pieces in plain bullets so procurement can pick a path.

Option A — Time-box extension (preferred for predictability)
- Extend pilot by N days (we typically offer 30-day increments).
- Price: flat fee $12,000 / 30 days (includes up to 8M tokens / month).
- Pros: fixed invoice, easy PO. Cons: unused capacity doesn't roll over.

Option B — Credit bucket (flexible, usage-based)
- Pre-purchased $/token credit: $9,500 for 8M-token bucket (can be consumed over 60 days).
- Pros: you only pay for consumed tokens; unused credits can be applied toward first month of Dedicated ramp.
- Cons: requires token accounting; we provide weekly burn reports.

Concession note (sales-approved floor)
- For pilots that convert to Dedicated within 90 days, we can apply a one-time credit equal to 10% of the pilot spend toward the first Dedicated invoice.

Approval path
- Sales (Ben) can approve up to 15% one-time concession.
- Anything above that requires Sr. Sales approval (Marissa).
- Legal/Finance: we have a one-page addendum template that covers term, data handling, and billing. I attached a draft addendum (pilot-addendum-draft.pdf) — it's intentionally slim.

Next steps
1) Tell me which option procurement prefers (A or B) and whether you want the extension to be 30 or 60 days.
2) If option B, we'll send a simple credit invoice and weekly usage report.
3) If option A, we'll route the addendum + PO to our Finance team for execution.

CC'ing Ben and Marissa to keep approvals visible.

Thanks —
Logan
